image_prompts.prompt: The character-consistent Mosasaurus hoffmannii from the config library at the starting line of the seaway. SUBJECT ANCHOR: Dark slate-blue skin, creamy-yellow underbelly, and dark clay spine frills. Deep sea-green with vertical white 'cracked' stripe patterns. ACTION: Emerging from the water, he is poised just beneath the surface with his massive head and jaw visible, creating an imposing, alert silhouette. FACIAL EXPRESSION: Fierce, determined, and authoritative, with his massive jaws slightly parted to show off his formidable pterygoid teeth. His glossy black eyes are locked forward. SETTING: The prehistoric seaway starting line, vibrant blue water with thick, sculptural 'clay' splash effects. ART STYLE: 'STYLE_ANIMATED_FEATURE_V3'. LIGHTING: 'SUNNY_EXPOSED_CINEMATIC'. FRAMING: 'SQUARE_HERO_CARD' front-three-quarter view to emphasize the power of his jaw.
